title: Sensitivity analysis of Stochastic Fluid Models: Stationary and transient quantities with applications
summary: We establish results for the first sensitivity analysis of the stochastic fluid models (SFMs). We derive expressions for the sensitivity analysis of the key stationary and transient (time-dependent) quantities of this class of models. We also construct numerical examples to demonstrate the application potential of our methodology in queueing systems, such as deteriorating systems and insurance risk processes. This work forms foundation for the sensitivity analysis of other Markovian modulated models, which are generalisations of the SFMs, and have widespread applications.
